question: How many cities belong to vidyā together with the seven tattvas beginning with puruṣa?
premises: World after world is placed in night, including the three cities of the sheath.
The city of speech and the city of measure are included.
Vidyā, joined with the seven tattvas beginning with puruṣa, has twenty-seven cities.
inference: The domain of vidyā together with the seven tattvas beginning with puruṣa comprises twenty-seven worlds in total.
uncertainties: The sense of 'niśi' (in night) as a cosmological division is not fully clear from this verse alone.
plain_english: World after world is set out, including the three sheath-cities, the city of speech, and the city of measure. Thus vidyā, together with the seven tattvas beginning with puruṣa, contains twenty-seven cities.
